description: This file defines the EchoSqlLogger class, which implements the SQLLogger interface for logging SQL queries, parameters, and types for debugging purposes within the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: EchoSqlLogger
classes.description: A logger class that outputs SQL queries and related parameters for debugging.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the logger, optionally replacing existing behavior based on the parameter.

methods.name: startQuery
methods.description: Outputs the SQL query, along with optional parameters and types, for debugging purposes.

methods.name: stopQuery
methods.description: A placeholder for stopping query logging; currently does nothing.
